text:
maria: Heads-up — staging started seeing weird token misalignment across requests after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak. Responses sometimes include tokens from previous user's prompt. :eyes:
jonathan: whoa. happening on which model/config? dedicated or hosted?
maria: repro on small local repro with seq_len ~ 12k (long-context). Dedicated config with continuous batching enabled.
adev: can you paste the minimal repro?
maria: repro steps: 
```
# checkout branch runtime/opt-route
make run-local
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-mini", "input":"A... (long)"}'
```
logs show this pattern: 
```
[KV] load_page page=7 slot=512 offset=120 align=8 req_id=0x1a3
[KV] append_chunk page=7 offset=128 token_start=48047
[KV] serve req=0x1a3 tokens=... (contains text from prev req)
```
jonathan: looks like append_offset changed by +8 vs expected +0 on some paths. alignment mismatch. did the new kernel change chunk-size or padding?
sree: the kernel change introduces a fast-path that pads to 64-byte lanes; we added an alignment fix for GPU memcpy that could shift logical offsets if not applied to the metadata path.
adev: that would explain +8 / +16 drifts. padding should be transparent — metadata must track pre/post pad offsets.
maria: observed contamination only when requests are batched and a subsequent request is shorter. Single-request runs are clean.
jonathan: probable race: batch split -> reuse slab without zeroing trailing bytes -> next req sees stale tokens. Could be a fragmentation + reuse issue rather than pure alignment.
sree: I found one suspicious change: in commit 7f3e, KVPage::append() moved padding into GPU copy path but left KVHeader::length update using unpadded length. That gives mismatch between header.offset and real appended bytes.
maria: exact log with hex: `hdr.len=0x78, mem.copied=0x80, next_offset=0x78`
adev: that would make next append start overlapping the last 8 bytes of previous chunk -> stale bytes read as part of new request.
jonathan: can we add an assert to compare header.len with copied_len in staging and crash early?
sree: yes will add assert + unit test. also propose zero-fill tail bytes on free to avoid accidental leak in case of future bugs.
maria: quick mitigation — disable the kernel fast-path (A/B toggle) and roll back padding change in canary.
adev: I'll prepare a small patch: revert the padding transform on metadata path and add strict checks.
ci-bot: build/RT-tests queued for runtime/patch/revert-padding (job 45321).
jonathan: also want a regression test that runs long-context multi-tenant workload (batching + interleaving) for 30s and validates token divergence. Add to nightly perf tests.
sree: noted. I'll own test + assert.
maria: assigned: sree (test + assert), adev (patch), jonathan (canary rollback plan).
adev: patch up in PR by EOD, linking logs and the minimal repro.
maria: thanks — will monitor staging after the canary revert. :thumbsup:
